More than 98,000 people signed a petition demanding democratic socialist Mayor Zohran Mamdani skip the 25th anniversary ceremony at Ground Zero, exposing deep political fault lines surrounding victim remembrance.

The Bright Side:
Families fiercely protect the sanctity of the memorial from perceived political opportunism.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing personal political grievances with collective memorial reverence (WHO vs WHAT), organizers turn a sacred day of unity into a battleground.

Social Physics Analysis:
Organizers execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver, leveraging genuine trauma as a pretext to isolate a political opponent while projecting malice onto his attendance.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated solemn unity and exclusionary political posturing, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Trust erodes as shared mourning fractures into sectarian tribalism.

The Unavoidable Truth: Families carry raw, enduring wounds that deserve profound respect and space.

The Unavoidable Lie: Petition campaigns can successfully police political thoughts without politicizing the memorial itself.
